title: House in the Highlands
description: Situated on 100 acres of lush farmland in the hills of Rincon, lies Casa en lo Alto. This guest house sits atop a hill on the private "finca" or small farm, Finca Joya Brava. Enjoy 360 degree views and organic fruit from your own private bungalow.The spaceSituated on 100 acres of lush farmland in the hills of Rincon, lies Casa en lo Alto. This guest house sits atop a hill on the private "finca" or small farm, Finca Joya Brava. Views from the house are 360 degrees; down to the beach, over to the mountains, the rolling green landscape, and the fruit and avocado trees. Depending on the season, guests can enjoy boundless organic tropical fruits and avocados. The property is unique to Rincon in that it offers a level of privacy and access to incredible grounds unmatched anywhere. Additionally, Rincon's best swimming beach is just a few minutes drive away. The guest house itself takes full advantage of its surroundings, with an expansive screened in porch affording views and the best of indoor/outdoor living year round. Thoughtfully stocked kitchen with all stainless steel appliances and gas stove. Guests can also enjoy a relaxing spa-like experience in our over sized fully tiled soaking tub. The house has it's own water heater so hot water is never an issue. Additionally, Casa en lo Alto come with full air conditioning should you prefer it.Other things to noteNo pets allowed. Please enjoy smoking, but only in the outside areas. Must be 25 years or older and present to rent this house. 3 night minimum stay & 7 night stay required for major holidays. House occupancy is 7 people maximum.

Steps away from restaurants and tourist life. An unforgettable experience.The spaceLocated on the seafront, private space, recently built. Features a bedroom with a queen-size bed and air conditioning. Kitchen equipped with a stove, refrigerator, and utensils. The living room has a futon that turns into a full bed. It has a TV and satellite channels. Beautiful ocean view from the bedroom and living room.Other things to noteTaxes are not included in the price of the stay. description: Spacious back unit with 2 bedrooms/2 bathrooms. Large balcony in the heart of Rincon plaza. Walking distance to fabulous restaurants.The spaceThis unit is on the second floor with a large balcony. 2 bedrooms/2 bathrooms. Dedicated office space.Other things to notePlease note that the Airbnb is located in Puerto Rico. As we are on an island, utilities such as electricity, water, and Wi-Fi can occasionally be interrupted without notice. Unlike the mainland, utility disruptions here may take several days to resolve. If you require reliable internet access for work during your stay, we strongly recommend bringing your own mobile hotspot and a back up power source, as uninterrupted service cannot be guaranteed.

description: Take it easy at this unique and tranquil getaway. Get lost in the sounds of nature-birds, the breeze and coquis-while just steps from the beach. This wooden retreat is warm and inviting with serenity woven into every nook and cranny. Tucked in a quiet valley of ever desired Puntas, Rincon you'll feel like you're in the jungle while being just 1/4 mile walk from the beach and just 1/2 mile from the Sandy Beach area with local bars/restaurants, gift shops and more.-Kare Management, Rincón, PRThe spaceWe offer basic WiFi but NO TV, take time and disconnect to reconnect :)Guest accessThe entire house is yours. There is another house on the property separated by a wooden fence so it is still very private and secluded. This house is accessed by concrete steps at the bottom of the property so it is not wheelchair accessible and not recommended for the elderly. We look forward to hosting you soon!

title: Paradise Palms Rincón Beachfront Condo w/Balcony
description: Wake up to ocean views in this serene 2 BR beachfront condo in a gated community in Rincón. Steps to the sand, with 2 pools, a full kitchen, and beach gear. Perfect for couples looking to unwind.The spaceWelcome to our little slice of paradise in Rincòn! This oceanfront 2-bedroom condo is a place we've loved and cared for - and we're excited to share it with guests who appreciate peace, comfort, and the sound of waves just outside the window.Perfect for couples or small groups, the condo comfortably sleeps two and offers a fully equipped kitchen, cozy living space, and a private balcony where you can sip your morning coffee or unwind with a sunset cocktail.You'll have full access to two adult pools and a kiddie pool, plus the beach is just steps away. We've stocked the place with little extras to make your stay feel like home-- snorkeling gear, beach chairs, beach towels and even an iron and ironing board if you're heading out for a nice dinner. There's reliable Wi-Fi, a smart TV for relaxing nights in, and air conditioning to keep you cool after a day in the sun. A coin operated washer and dryer are available in the building lobby, and you'll have your own designated parking spot. We recommend renting a car to explore all that Rincón has to offer--great restaurants, hidden beaches, and colorful local spots are just a short drive away. Whether you're here to surf, relax, or reconnect, we hope this space feels like your home away from home.Guest accessYou'll have access to the entire condo, balcony, the shared pools, beachfront, one designated parking spot, the outdoor shared grill and the laundry machines in the lobby.Other things to noteWe love this corner of Puerto Rico and are always happy to share local tips, favorite restaurants, or hidden beach spots if you're looking for recommendations. Just ask-- we're here to make your stay memorable!

title: Coral Suite | Cozy Stay Near Rincón
description: Cozy hillside suite in Rincón, just minutes from beach and town.Located about 10 minutes from Rincón’s beaches and downtown, this comfortable 1BR, 1BA suite features coral-inspired decor and a sofa bed, ideal for couples or small families. The property runs on solar energy and includes a shared 600-gallon water tank to provide added comfort during service interruptions. A calm and relaxed stay in a peaceful area.The spaceCoral is our coziest unit, perfect for up to four guests. Though it’s our smallest, it offers all the comfort you need. This one-bedroom, one-bathroom unit features a fully equipped kitchen, a comfy living room with a sofa bed, a dining area, free Wi-Fi, and a Smart TV. Unit #3 of the property also includes one assigned parking space. Thoughtfully designed to feel warm and inviting, Coral makes a great home base for your Rincón escape.Guest accessCheck-in is self-service through a secure lockbox located just outside the unit. You are welcome to check in any time after 3:00 PM, unless an early check-in has been previously arranged and approved. The lockbox code will be sent closer to your arrival time, and it changes after each guest to ensure security.Other things to noteBefore You Book – What to Know 🏞️El Danuview sits on a lush Rincón hillside, just 10 minutes from downtown and the beach! But to get this view, you’ll travel up scenic, curvy roads—some steep, narrow, and one-lane in parts. It’s part of the adventure, so we highly recommend having a car.Also, while the area is full of natural beauty and laid-back vibes, it can get lively—especially on weekends or during holidays. You might hear music, parties, or other celebrations. It’s part of the colorful, vibrant culture that makes Puerto Rico so alive. If you’re seeking silence 24/7, this might not be the perfect fit—but if you love energy, sunshine, and mountain views, you’ll feel right at home!Traveling with a Group? Discover Danuview Suites! ✨While you’re viewing this specific unit, don’t miss the opportunity to book multiple suites together ideal for family vacations, group getaways, retreats, or celebrations.Here are our tailored group options:• 8 guests in 2 units: La Montaña + Coral• 12 guests in 2 units: La Palma + La Ola• 16 guests in 3 units: La Palma + La Ola + La Montaña• 20 guests when booking all 4 suites: La Palma, La Ola, La Montaña, and CoralEach suite is fully equipped and thoughtfully designed—offering comfort, privacy, and easy access to pools, beach-style amenities, and shared spaces. You’ll enjoy staying close while still having the room to unwind.Send us a message to check availability for your group—we’re happy to help create the perfect stay.Together is better at Danuview Suites.Attention to all our potential guests:- We have stocked the space with essential items, however, you will likely need to supplement with your own during your stay such as toilet paper, paper towels, soaps, etc

description: Corsica 25 is a beautiful, comfortable, and cozy casita, your perfect escape in Rincón, Puerto Rico. Just a short walk from Corcega Beach, you can spend your days by the ocean and then relax in the pool, jacuzzi, and gazebo area. Conveniently located close to restaurants and shops. Corsica 25 offers the perfect blend of tranquility and easy access to everything Rincón has to offer.The spaceThis charming one-bedroom casita is the perfect getaway for couples, solo travelers, or digital nomads looking to experience the laid-back lifestyle of Puerto Rico’s west coast. Located just a short walk from Corcega Beach, you can spend your days enjoying the sun and surf before returning home to relax and unwind.Nestled within a gated community, guests have access to wonderful shared amenities, including a swimming pool, jacuzzi, and gazebo area. The apartment offers 223.25 m² of space and includes one assigned parking spot for your convenience.Thoughtfully designed for remote workers, the apartment features two dedicated workspaces with desks, making it ideal for a working couple or anyone who needs a comfortable and productive environment while enjoying island life.Centrally located, Corsica 25 is just minutes from Rincón’s best beaches, restaurants, cafés, and shops, making it easy to explore everything this vibrant beach town has to offer. Whether you're visiting for a romantic escape, a surfing adventure, or an extended work-from-paradise stay, Corsica 25 is the perfect home base.

Features include Sofa sleeper, queen bed, bed and bath linens, flat screen TV, Complimentary secured wireless internet, private bathroom, microwave oven, fridge, coffee maker, stove top, shampoo and conditioner, body wash, and beach towels. -Unit 4 is a studio equipped with a full bed, kitchenette, workspace, TV and bathroom. Features include Plush full bed, bed and bath linens, flat screen smart TV, complimentary wireless internet, private bathroom, microwave oven, fridge, coffee maker, shampoo and conditioner, body wash, and beach towels. The enclosed property includes a beautiful pool, sun loungers, luxury patio furniture, gas and coal grills (BBQ) and outdoor shower. The whole building is equipped with an automatic generator to protect your vacation investment from common island power outages.Guest accessAt the property, guest have access to pool, outdoor shower, gas and coal grill (BBQ), sun loungers and outdoor patio lounge.The neighborhood in very walkable, but you will most likely want a car to go downtown, visit other beaches and other parts of the island and to do grocery shopping.There is free onsite parking at the property and on the street.Other things to noteWhile we provide internet service, generator in case of very common power outages and water in case water goes out as well, we do ask that you are conscious that these are not fail proof. If any of these were to fail during your stay rest assured, we will do everything in our power to resolve the issue in a timely manner, also taking into consideration the maintenance personnel and technician’s availability and abilities.
